t: This is Connaught Place, a street in Bayswater in the City of Westminster. Marble Arch tube station is a few minutes' walk east, close to the site of the Tyburn Tree. Several notable people have connections to the street. Rachel Parsons, the engineer and advocate for women's employment rights, was born here, and she became the founding President of the Women's Engineering Society in 1919. The diplomat Hussey Vivian, the third Baron Vivian, was also born here. Geoffrey Hope-Morley, the second Baron Hollenden, who served as High Sheriff of the County of London, lived here.
